title: Conditional two-orientation state-weighted shell-tail transfer
question: Given the already registered state-weighted per-edge fourth-power majorant and the exact rectangular shell tail, what two-orientation tail envelope follows without assuming an actual Q3 history or operator domain?

theorem.conditional_input: For each orientation sigma in {-1,+1}, ||X_(sigma,e)||_L4^4 <= C4_edge*w(e)^4
theorem.root_free_certificate: For each orientation B_sigma(R)^4 <= C4_edge*T(R)^4 and the two orientation fourth-power envelope is <= 2*C4_edge*T(R)^4

finite_fixture.edge_set: positive-coordinate nearest-neighbour edges in ordered rectangular boxes
finite_fixture.fixture_scope: Exact rational shell and conditional-envelope audit; no new Gibbs trace, matrix evolution, or Q3 owner is introduced.

assumptions: The local-force fourth-power constant and endpoint third-moment bridge are used only in the finite parent scope of EXP-001320.
Every actual edge term supplied later must satisfy the stated per-edge L4 fourth-power majorant in both orientations.
The rectangular edge family and nonnegative lower-endpoint shell weight are exactly the R-444 contract.
The triangle inequality may be used for an eventual sum of L4 norms only after a common state/domain contract is supplied.
All derived constants and shell envelopes are recomputed from the parent manifests; no fitted spatial constant is introduced.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK history that supplies actual coefficients and per-edge terms for every edge and both orientations.
A common unbounded domain or form topology converting the finite L4 interface into the required Q3 seminorm.
Source-, beta-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform parent constants beyond the registered finite scopes.
A two-sided product/Volterra or Duhamel estimate, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy theorem and common-alpha identification.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.check: The shell transfer starts from an explicit per-edge L4 fourth-power hypothesis and never asserts that exact Q3 history terms satisfy it.
Both orientations are counted explicitly; the factor two is not hidden inside a fitted constant or identified with an adjoint history identity.
The [2,8]^3 boxes and radii 1..12 are an exact finite audit of the ambient scalar bound, not a thermodynamic or exhaustion limit.
The primary certificate records the symbolic fourth root, while all machine inequalities are checked in root-free fourth-power form.
The package composes existing T-054 R-444/R-445/EXP-001320 interfaces and does not alter the forward theorem order, candidate definitions, or additive inverse lane.
No common core, actual Q3 history, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, physical, continuum, Yang--Mills, or mass-gap flag is enabled.

evidence_level: T0 exact conditional two-orientation root-free fourth-power shell-envelope transfer
boundary: This result supplies a reusable conditional shell envelope for two orientation families after an explicit per-edge state-weighted L4 majorant is assumed. It does not prove that exact Q3LOCK history terms satisfy that hypothesis, does not construct a common weighted operator domain, and does not close any thermodynamic, physical, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap gate.
non_claims: No actual Q3LOCK commutator or history term is shown to obey the per-edge hypothesis.
The fourth root is a symbolic envelope constant; the exact machine certificate is fourth-power only.
The finite rectangular audit is not an all-shape exhaustion or volume-limit theorem.
No operator norm, common core, Duhamel/Volterra, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, physical-empty, Sector-A, Pre-A, Yang--Mills or mass-gap conclusion follows.
The established T-054 forward method, owner order and observation-first inverse lane remain unchanged.
next_action: Use this envelope only after a source-owned Q3 history supplies the per-edge L4 hypothesis on one common domain; then prove the actual two-sided history recurrence and all-shape exhaustion Cauchy estimate. Do not create another finite mobility table.
stop_or_redesign: If a future per-edge term violates the coefficient or weight contract, record that history-local failure instead of enlarging C4 after target disclosure.
If an L4-to-operator/form conversion is unavailable, retain this as a conditional interface and do not promote it.
If parent shell geometry changes, recompute all tail rows from the new parent hash.
If a proposed use would change the established T-054 method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.

lean_crosscheck.role: Lean checks the exact orientation factor, shell-tail arithmetic and one coefficient-weight inequality; it does not formalize Q3 operators, domains, histories or limits.
